title: Rules
description: Every rule in the pawl standard, its level, and the Biome rule that enforces it.

<!-- Generated by packages/pawl/scripts/build-rules-doc.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

The standard has 169 rules. Names are ESLint's names; use them in `rules` in a policy. Run `pawl explain <rule>` to see a rule's level in your repo.

On top of these, pawl turns on Biome's own recommended rules for each technology a project uses: react, next, react-native, qwik, solid, vue, svelte, astro, tailwind, tanstack-query, drizzle, playwright, turbo.

A **guardrail** rule guards against a mistake coding agents make often. A rule that is **unstable** in the engine that enforces it is off unless the policy is strict. A rule with no Biome rule is enforced by Oxlint, or by ESLint with the plugin installed.

| `vitest/consistent-test-it`    | Enforce consistent use of it or test for test functions.                       | warn                     | `style/useConsistentTestIt`              |                            |
| `vitest/expect-expect`         | Ensure that test functions contain at least one expect() or similar assertion. | error                    | `suspicious/useExpect`                   |                            |
| `vitest/max-nested-describe`   | This rule enforces a maximum depth to nested describe() in test files.         | error                    | `complexity/noExcessiveNestedTestSuites` |                            |
| `vitest/no-identical-title`    | Disallow identical titles in test suites and test cases.                       | error                    | `suspicious/noIdenticalTestTitle`        |                            |
| `vitest/prefer-to-be`          | Use toBe() to compare primitive values.                                        | warn                     |                                          | Oxlint or an ESLint plugin |
| `vitest/prefer-to-have-length` | Use toHaveLength() to check a length.                                          | warn                     |                                          | Oxlint or an ESLint plugin |
| `vitest/valid-expect`          | Call expect() with one value and a matcher.                                    | error                    |                                          | Oxlint or an ESLint plugin |

## Markdown and YAML

| Rule                            | What it checks                                | Level                   | Biome rule                           | Notes             |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ----------------- |
| `markdown/fenced-code-language` | Name the language of every fenced code block. | off (error when strict) | `nursery/useFencedCodeLanguage`      | unstable in Biome |
| `markdown/heading-increment`    | Raise heading levels one at a time.           | off (error when strict) | `nursery/useConsistentHeadingLevel`  | unstable in Biome |
| `yml/no-empty-sequence-entry`   | No empty entries in a YAML list.              | off (error when strict) | `nursery/noYamlEmptySequenceEntries` | unstable in Biome |

## Turborepo

Applied only in a Turborepo.

| Rule                           | What it checks                                        | Level | Biome rule                       | Notes |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- | ----- | -------------------------------- | ----- |
| `turbo/no-undeclared-env-vars` | Disallow the use of undeclared environment variables. | error | `suspicious/noUndeclaredEnvVars` |       |

## Pawl

Checked by pawl itself, on top of the engines.

| Rule                    | What it checks                             | Level | Biome rule | Notes     |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ----- | ---------- | --------- |
| `pawl/format`           | The file is not formatted to the standard. | error |            |           |
| `pawl/organize-imports` | Imports are not sorted.                    | error |            |           |
| `pawl/no-new-disable`   | No new comments that switch a check off.   | error |            | guardrail |
